correctness.rationale: Wrapping the actual source survival law S(x)=exp(-phi x)(1+phi x+phi³)/(1+phi³) gives a normalized positive mass f(r)=K q^r(b+r). Its ratio f(r+1)/f(r)=q(1+1/(b+r)) is strictly decreasing in r and f(r+1)>f(r) iff r<H_m(phi), with H_m=2/(e^phi-1)-m/(e^{m phi}-1)-1/phi-phi². The decomposition H_m=1/sinh(phi)-1/phi-phi² + [2/(e^{2phi}-1)-m/(e^{m phi}-1)] has strictly negative derivative by the stated sinh(t)/t monotonicity and elementary hyperbolic inequalities, including m=2. Limits H_m(0+)=m/2-1 and H_m(infty)=-infty imply exactly k_m=floor((m-1)/2) transitions and modes only 0..k_m. Exact equality yields exactly adjacent ties; no rotated-origin claim. Independently checked normalization and several transition/boundary cases by direct wrap and closed mass, not treated as an all-parameter proof.
residual_risks: All comparisons are for the canonical fixed-origin labels and phi>0, not a freely rotated circular location family.
